items.description: Placed LB JD Bertrand on injured reserve. Signed LB Josh Woods from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed QB Josh Johnson, TE Tanner Hudson, CB Trikweze Bridges, OT Blake Freeland and DE Garmon Randolph to the practice squad.

Signed CB Noah Igbinoghene and DE Sam Williams to the active roster. Placed DT Kalia Davis on injured reserve. Waived CB Michael Coats Jr. Signed DTs Sam Kamara and Chris Williams, RB Jaleel McLaughlin and TE Messiah Swinson to the practice squad.
Signed QB Kedon Slovis to the practice squad.

Signed ILB Liam Anderson, EDGEs Clelin Ferrell, Amari Gainer and Max Llewellyn, DLs Jordan Miller and Mazi Smith, WR Will Sheppard, CBs Jaylin Simpson and Ethan Bonner and TE Tre Watson to the practice squad. Released QB Mark Gronowski, TE Jeremiah Franklin and ILB Cam Riley from the practice squad.
Signed TE Cam Grandy and DL Naquan Jones to the practice squad. Released TE Marshall Lang from the practice squad.
Re-signed C Ben Brown to the 53-man roster. Signed LB Erick Hunter to the 53-man roster. Signed LBs K.J. Britt and Jose Ramirez, DT Jalen Hunt and OL Jake Kubas to the practice squad.
Signed WR Danny Gray, OL Kiran Amegadjie, CB Robert Longerbeam and RB Jaydon Blue to the practice squad.
Signed DL Jared Harrison-Hunte and OL Vershon Lee to the practice squad.
Signed T Esa Pole, TEs Joshua Simon and Jack Westover and CB Isaac Yiadom to the practice squad.
Placed OL Brady Christensen on injured reserve. Signed LB Bobby Okereke. Signed LB Tyrel Dodson and DT Anthony Goodlow to the practice squad.
Claimed LB Yasir Abdullah off waivers from Jacksonville, OLB Jared Ivey from Seattle and T Cameron Williams from Philadelphia.
Claimed OT Myles Hinton off waivers from Philadelphia.
Claimed DB Toriano Pride off waivers from Buffalo.
Claimed RB Emari Demercado off waivers from Kansas City.
Claimed LB Owen Pappoe off waivers from Arizona, DT Nazir Stackhouse from Green Bay and DB Melvin Smith from Kansas City.
Claimed DB Kapena Gushiken off waivers from Philadelphia.
Claimed DT Bryson Eason off waivers from San Francisco and DE Jack Pyburn from Tampa Bay.
Claimed DB Darrell Luter off waivers from San Francisco.

Claimed DBs Julius Wood from Dallas, Marcellas Dial from New England and Reese Taylor from Denver, QB Brady Cook from the New York Jets, Ts Chukwuebuka Godrick from Kansas City and Jarrett Kingston from Houston and TE Justin Joly from Denver.
Claimed C Nick Samac off waivers from Carolina and G Trevor Keegan from Dallas.
Claimed LB Darius Muasau off waivers from the New York Giants and TE Cameron Latu from Philadelphia.
Claimed DT Colby Wooden off waivers from Indianapolis and OT Mason Murphy from Chicago.
Claimed K Blake Grupe off waivers from Indianapolis and LB Trevin Wallace from Carolina.
Claimed C Corey Bullock off waivers from Baltimore.
